svg.title: Federation between two independent GusVoice servers
svg.desc: Server A, with people A, B and C, links to Server B, with people D, E and F. Both admins approve the link. Signed HTTP using RFC 9421 connects them in both directions. Guests join with their own account and send DMs across servers. Each side keeps a copy, which survives a peer outage. Federation is off by default.

g.aria-label: guests join with their own account
g.title: guests join with their own account
